title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Crosses Rs 15 Crore in India Presales With 12 Days Still to Go
excerpt: Tom Holland's fourth solo Spider-Man film is on track for the second-biggest Hollywood opening day in India, with PVRINOX selling over 200,000 weekend tickets and Prasads in Hyderabad already sold out.
body:
Key Takeaways
  • Spider-Man: Brand New Day has surpassed Rs 15 crore in advance bookings in India.
  • PVRINOX sold over 200,000 tickets worth Rs 11.50 crore for the opening weekend.
  • The film is projected to earn Rs 40-48 crore on opening day, challenging records.
  • Standard format bookings just opened, with major cinema chains yet to start sales.
  • The film's presales indicate strong audience interest ahead of its July 30 release.
